purpose: Teach: 慎太郎/康夫/優美/和也/正彦/すず/恭子/足下

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「石原慎太郎元都知事の本を読もう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying he wants to read that book by Shinzo Ishihara.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational. Warm observation offered as a bridge between them. Pause after the name, giving space for his response. Light, not heavy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと康夫おじさんの家に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went to visit Dad and Uncle Yasuo's place.
lines.style: Bright and present. Quick, eager rhythm. Words tumbling out because he wants her to know. Small-boy pride in having done something. Genuine excitement, not performed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「優美さんは芸術家肌」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying Yumi-san has that artist's sensibility, doesn't she.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. Slight smile in the voice — affectionate observation about someone she respects. Not judgmental, appreciative. Softer landing at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと和也いとこと水族館に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went to the aquarium with Dad and my cousin Kazu.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delight. The clarity of a child who has something worth sharing. Not boasting — just telling. Natural pace, no seeking approval.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「正彦おじいちゃんに会いに行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying we should go visit Grandpa Masahiko.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion wrapped in affection. The tone of someone relaying something she finds meaningful. Slight reverence for the grandfather — not heavy, just present. Warm exhale at the period.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとペットのすずちゃんと遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I played with Dad and Suzu-chan at home.
lines.style: Soft and contented. The kind of quiet joy in small things — a pet, his father, nothing fancy. Small voice but full presence. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「恭子おばさんの和菓子は絶品」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying that Aunt Kyoko's Japanese sweets are absolutely incredible.
lines.style: Appreciation in the voice — quoting something genuine with a small smile. Genuine pleasure at the memory. Slight pause before the last word, letting the compliment land.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「足下を見て歩く事も大事」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad taught me something important — to watch where my feet are going, even when I walk.
lines.style: Thoughtful, earnest. This is a lesson he's holding onto. Slow, deliberate pace — the words have weight. Quiet conviction without being solemn. Small, genuine care in the delivery.
